precipitation.completeness: 20 annual records for each of two area IDs; valid_months = 12 in every row

nasa_power_jericho_point_rainfall.validation: Table structure and daily counts reviewed; original NASA POWER response was not independently inspected

source_evidence.import_note: Add files via upload — data for area a and b
source_evidence.interpretation: Repository upload documents file arrival, not Earth Engine execution or NASA origin.

validation.structural_checks: passed — row counts, year coverage, IDs, uniqueness, value bounds and quality-count fields
validation.source_provenance: pending — missing Earth Engine task logs and original output comparison

limitations: The repository currently lacks independently inspected Earth Engine run history and raw export artifacts for the uploaded files.
GeoJSON geometry validity does not prove that the polygons were used to extract the current CSV values.
The polygon land-use labels are candidate descriptions and require independent supporting evidence.
MODIS NDVI 250 m and GPM IMERG ~11.1 km pixel sizes differ substantially; small neighboring polygons may share rainfall pixels.
Annual NDVI aggregation in the script averages spatial means of valid composites, not a fully area- and time-weighted pixel average.
No causal claims about irrigation, ecosystem health or land use should be inferred from NDVI/rainfall alone.
The separate NASA POWER point series cannot replace two polygon-specific rainfall series.
